warnings.message: npm: npx, npm exec and npm x pick the version of a package they download with the release-age delay alone and do not read min-release-age-exclude, so they still hold new versions of @acme/* and left-pad back for cooldown.minimum
warnings.fix: Install such a package with npm install, which reads min-release-age-exclude, and run it from node_modules/.bin: npx runs it from there without downloading it

warnings.message: Dependabot: cooldown.exclude in .github/dependabot.yml (line 22) for npm updates exempts react from the release-age delay, but cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json does not; depcurfew apply comments it out, so Dependabot delays it like every other package
warnings.fix: To keep the exception, add "react" to cooldown.exclude in depcurfew.json and run depcurfew apply again
